provenance.note: Practice questions for PIEAS BS Admission Test. Per the official pattern: 100 MCQs, 3 hours, no negative marking. Mathematics 30, Physics 30, Chemistry 20, English 20. Not affiliated with PIEAS.

marking.note: 100 MCQs, 100 marks, no negative marking (PIEAS pattern).

questions.stem: If 3x - 6 = 0, what is the value of x?
Simplify: 4a + 3b - 2a + b.
questions.explanation: 4a - 2a = 2a; 3b + b = 4b; result = 2a + 4b.

questions.stem: If f(x) = 3x - 1, what is f(0)?
The solution set of x² = 36 is:
What is the exact value of sin 90°?
questions.explanation: sin 90° = 1, a standard trigonometric value.

questions.stem: What is log₅ 25?
questions.explanation: 5² = 25, so log₅ 25 = 2.

questions.stem: The coefficient of x in 7x - 3 is:
questions.explanation: In the term 7x, the coefficient of x is 7.

questions.stem: If a = 2 and b = 3, what is a²b?
The sum of the interior angles of a triangle is:
questions.explanation: The interior angles of a triangle always sum to 180°.

questions.stem: What is 2/5 expressed as a percentage?
The distance between the points (0, 0) and (3, 4) is:
If x + y = 10 and x - y = 4, what is the value of x?
questions.explanation: Adding the two equations: 2x = 14 → x = 7.

questions.stem: Solve: 2x² + 5x - 3 = 0.
If f(x) = x³ - 2x, what is f(-1)?
The slope of the line passing through (1, 2) and (3, 8) is:
What is the exact value of sec 60°?
What is the derivative of 5x³ with respect to x?
questions.explanation: d/dx (5x³) = 5 × 3x² = 15x².

questions.stem: The 7th term of the geometric progression 2, 6, 18, ... is:
The probability of getting an even number when a fair six-sided die is rolled is:
questions.explanation: Even numbers: 2, 4, 6 (3 out of 6) = 3/6 = 1/2.

questions.stem: The roots of the equation x² - 6x + 9 = 0 are:
questions.explanation: x² - 6x + 9 = (x - 3)², so the roots are x = 3 (repeated).

questions.stem: The area of a triangle with base 10 cm and height 6 cm is:
questions.explanation: Area = (1/2) × base × height = (1/2) × 10 × 6 = 30 cm².

questions.stem: If log₁₀ 2 ≈ 0.3010 and log₁₀ 3 ≈ 0.4771, then log₁₀ 6 is approximately:
What is the exact value of cos 0°?
questions.explanation: cos 0° = 1, a standard trigonometric value.

questions.stem: If the sum of the first n terms of an arithmetic progression is n(n+1), the first term is:
questions.explanation: S₁ = 1(1+1) = 2, so the first term is 2.

questions.stem: Evaluate ∫₁³ (2x + 3) dx.
If f(x) = sin x + cos x, what is f'(π/4)?
How many 4-digit numbers can be formed using digits 1 through 9 without repetition?
questions.explanation: First digit: 9 choices; then 8, 7, 6 = 9 × 8 × 7 × 6 = 3024.

questions.stem: The slope of the tangent to the curve y = x² at x = 2 is:
questions.explanation: dy/dx = 2x; at x = 2 the slope is 4.

questions.stem: The sum of the infinite geometric series 1 + 1/2 + 1/4 + 1/8 + ... is:
If sin θ = 3/5 and θ is acute, what is tan θ?
Mass is measured in:
questions.explanation: The SI unit of mass is the kilogram (kg).

questions.stem: Which of the following is a scalar quantity?
questions.explanation: Speed has magnitude only; all others have both magnitude and direction.

questions.stem: The weight of a 1 kg mass at Earth's surface (g ≈ 10 m/s²) is:
questions.explanation: Weight = mg = 1 × 10 = 10 N.

questions.stem: A boy walks 60 m in 30 s. His average speed is:
questions.explanation: Speed = distance/time = 60/30 = 2 m/s.

questions.stem: The SI unit of pressure is the:
questions.explanation: Pressure = force/area; its SI unit is the pascal (Pa).

questions.stem: The frequency of a wave is measured in:
questions.explanation: Frequency is measured in hertz (Hz), which is cycles per second.

questions.stem: A convex lens is also called a:
questions.explanation: A convex lens converges light rays and is called a converging lens.

questions.stem: Current is measured in amperes using an instrument called:
questions.explanation: An ammeter measures electric current in amperes.

questions.stem: Which type of electromagnetic radiation has the highest frequency?
questions.explanation: Gamma rays have the highest frequency and shortest wavelength in the EM spectrum.

questions.stem: The instrument used to measure atmospheric pressure is the:
questions.explanation: Atmospheric pressure is measured by a barometer.

questions.stem: When a body is at rest, its kinetic energy is:
questions.explanation: Kinetic energy depends on motion; a body at rest has zero kinetic energy.

questions.stem: The time period of a wave is the reciprocal of its:
questions.explanation: T = 1/f, where f is the frequency.

questions.stem: A 5 kg mass is lifted vertically through 4 m. The work done (g = 10 m/s²) is:
The gravitational force between two masses is F. If the distance between them is doubled, the force becomes:
questions.explanation: Gravitational force is inversely proportional to the square of distance: F ∝ 1/r².

questions.stem: A car's velocity changes from 10 m/s to 30 m/s in 4 s. The acceleration is:
The image formed by a plane mirror is:
questions.explanation: A plane mirror always forms a virtual, erect image of the same size as the object.

questions.stem: The SI unit of electric charge is the:
questions.explanation: Electric charge is measured in coulombs (C).

questions.stem: The energy of a photon is given by E = hf. If the frequency doubles, the photon energy:
questions.explanation: Photon energy is directly proportional to frequency: E ∝ f, so doubling f doubles E.

questions.stem: A body of mass 2 kg moves in a circle of radius 3 m at a speed of 6 m/s. The centripetal force is:
When light travels from air into glass, which property decreases?
questions.explanation: Light slows down when entering a denser medium; frequency and period remain unchanged.

questions.stem: A sound wave has a frequency of 256 Hz. If the speed of sound is 340 m/s, the wavelength is approximately:
The half-life of a radioactive substance is 4 days. After 8 days, the fraction remaining is:
questions.explanation: 8 days = 2 half-lives; remaining = (1/2)² = 1/4.

questions.stem: Three resistors of 2 Ω, 3 Ω and 5 Ω are connected in series. The total resistance is:
questions.explanation: In series resistances add: 2 + 3 + 5 = 10 Ω.

questions.stem: A stone is dropped from rest. After 2 seconds (g = 10 m/s²), its velocity is:
questions.explanation: v = u + gt = 0 + 10(2) = 20 m/s downward.

questions.stem: A projectile is launched at 60° to the horizontal with speed 20 m/s. Its maximum height (g = 10 m/s²) is:
A 4 μF capacitor and a 6 μF capacitor are connected in series. The equivalent capacitance is:
A wire of resistance R is stretched uniformly to twice its original length. Its new resistance is:
questions.explanation: Volume constant: length doubles, area halves. R' = ρ(2L)/(A/2) = 4ρL/A = 4R.

questions.stem: In the Bohr model of hydrogen, the first Bohr radius is 0.529 Å. The radius of the second orbit is:
In an AC generator, the induced EMF is maximum when the plane of the coil is:
questions.explanation: EMF = NBAωsin(ωt); maximum when the plane is parallel to the field (sin = 1).

questions.stem: An object is placed 30 cm in front of a convex lens of focal length 10 cm. The image distance is:
The smallest particle of an element that retains its chemical properties is the:
questions.explanation: An atom is the smallest unit of an element that retains its chemical identity.

questions.stem: The chemical formula of water is:
questions.explanation: Water's formula is H₂O (two hydrogen, one oxygen).

questions.stem: Which gas is most abundant in the Earth's atmosphere?
questions.explanation: Nitrogen (N₂) makes up about 78% of the atmosphere.

questions.stem: The pH of a strong acid solution is:
questions.explanation: Strong acids have a pH well below 7.

questions.stem: Magnesium has atomic number 12. Its valency is:
questions.explanation: Mg has electron configuration 2,8,2; it loses 2 electrons, so valency is 2.

questions.stem: Which of the following is a noble gas?
questions.explanation: Neon (Ne) is a noble gas, found in Group 18 of the periodic table.

questions.stem: The process by which a solid changes directly into a gas is called:
questions.explanation: Sublimation is the direct transition from solid to gas without an intermediate liquid phase.

questions.stem: The number of hydrogen atoms in one molecule of H₂SO₄ is:
questions.explanation: H₂SO₄ contains two hydrogen atoms per molecule.

questions.stem: How many moles are present in 18 g of water (H = 1, O = 16)?
questions.explanation: Molar mass of H₂O = 2 + 16 = 18 g/mol; 18/18 = 1 mol.

questions.stem: In NaCl, the bond between sodium and chlorine is classified as:
questions.explanation: Na transfers an electron to Cl, forming Na⁺ and Cl⁻ ions held by electrostatic attraction — an ionic bond.

questions.stem: The empirical formula of glucose (C₆H₁₂O₆) is:
questions.explanation: Divide all subscripts by 6: C₆H₁₂O₆ → CH₂O.

questions.stem: The oxidation state of sulfur in H₂SO₄ is:
Which of the following conducts electricity in the molten state?
questions.explanation: Ionic compounds like NaCl conduct electricity when molten, as ions become mobile.

questions.stem: The gas evolved when calcium carbonate reacts with dilute HCl is:
questions.explanation: CaCO₃ + 2HCl → CaCl₂ + H₂O + CO₂; carbon dioxide gas is released.

questions.stem: Which of the following is a strong acid?
questions.explanation: HCl (hydrochloric acid) is a strong acid, fully dissociating in water.

questions.stem: The number of neutrons in an atom of ²³Na (atomic number 11) is:
questions.explanation: Neutrons = mass number - atomic number = 23 - 11 = 12.

questions.stem: 20 g of NaOH (molar mass = 40 g/mol) is dissolved in water to make 500 cm³ of solution. The molarity is:
In the reaction N₂ + 3H₂ → 2NH₃, how many moles of NH₃ are formed from 6 moles of H₂?
questions.explanation: Mole ratio H₂:NH₃ = 3:2; 6 × (2/3) = 4 mol NH₃.

questions.stem: The hybridization of carbon in methane (CH₄) is:
questions.explanation: Carbon in CH₄ forms four single bonds — sp³ hybridization with tetrahedral geometry.

questions.stem: Which of the following has the highest boiling point?
questions.explanation: NaCl is an ionic compound with strong electrostatic forces; it has a much higher boiling point than molecular compounds.

questions.stem: Choose the correct synonym of 'happy':
questions.explanation: 'Happy' and 'joyful' both describe a feeling of pleasure or contentment.

questions.stem: The plural of 'woman' is:
questions.explanation: 'Woman' is an irregular noun; its plural is 'women'.

questions.stem: Choose the correctly spelled word:
questions.explanation: 'Receive' follows the rule 'i before e except after c'.

questions.stem: She ___ a letter to her friend yesterday.
questions.explanation: 'Yesterday' requires the simple past tense 'wrote'.

questions.stem: An antonym of 'difficult' is:
questions.explanation: 'Easy' is the direct opposite of 'difficult'.

questions.stem: He is ___ honest man. Choose the correct article:
questions.explanation: 'Honest' begins with a silent 'h', so the article 'an' is used.

questions.stem: The word 'quickly' is an:
questions.explanation: 'Quickly' describes how an action is performed, making it an adverb.

questions.stem: Complete: The weather is ___ today than yesterday.
questions.explanation: The comparative form 'better' is used with 'than'.

questions.stem: Bees play an essential role in agriculture by pollinating crops. Without bees, the yields of many fruits and vegetables would decline sharply. Beekeepers move their hives across regions to coincide with flowering seasons. According to the passage, bees contribute to agriculture by:
questions.explanation: The passage states bees 'pollinating crops' is their essential agricultural role.

questions.stem: Choose the word most similar in meaning to 'fragile':
questions.explanation: 'Fragile' means easily broken; 'delicate' is the closest synonym.

questions.stem: Neither the manager nor the employees ___ satisfied with the decision.
questions.explanation: With 'neither...nor', the verb agrees with the nearer subject 'employees' (plural), so 'were' is correct.

questions.stem: Choose the correct sentence:
options: The team are playing well today.
The team is playing well today.
The team were play well today.
questions.explanation: 'Team' is a collective noun taking a singular verb in standard English: 'the team is playing'.

questions.stem: The Karakoram Highway, completed in 1978, links Pakistan with China across the Karakoram mountains. It is one of the highest paved roads in the world, crossing the Khunjerab Pass at about 4,700 metres. The Karakoram Highway connects Pakistan with:
questions.explanation: The passage states the highway links Pakistan with China.

questions.stem: The opposite of 'permanent' is:
questions.explanation: 'Temporary' is the direct opposite of 'permanent'.

questions.stem: If he had studied harder, he ___ the exam.
questions.explanation: Third conditional: 'if + past perfect, would have + past participle'.

questions.stem: Choose the word closest in meaning to 'reluctant':
questions.explanation: 'Reluctant' means hesitant or unwilling to do something.

questions.stem: Choose the word most nearly opposite in meaning to 'verbose':
questions.explanation: 'Verbose' means using more words than needed; 'concise' means brief and to the point.

questions.stem: Recent studies suggest that regular physical exercise improves not only cardiovascular health but also cognitive function, particularly memory and attention. The effect appears strongest when exercise is sustained over months rather than weeks. According to the passage, the cognitive benefits of exercise:
options: appear immediately after a single session
are strongest when exercise continues over months
have been disproved by recent studies
questions.explanation: The passage states the cognitive benefits 'appear strongest when exercise is sustained over months'.

questions.stem: Choose the correct sentence with subject–verb agreement:
options: Each of the students have submitted their assignment.
Each of the students has submitted the assignment.
Each of the student has submitted the assignment.
Each students has submitted the assignment.
questions.explanation: 'Each of the' takes a plural noun but a singular verb: 'has submitted'.

questions.stem: The manager's decision was arbitrary. 'Arbitrary' most nearly means:
questions.explanation: 'Arbitrary' means based on random choice or personal whim rather than reason.
